components.title: Snapshot, delta, replay and fan-out

steps.description: Captures engine interfaces, creates scheduler, loads setup/scripts and constructs managers.
Conditionally pushes built-in managers as active modules and always pushes the gRPC gateway.
Validates config, endpoint and token; creates state, queue, admin and service objects.
Writes the initial healthy marker.
Restricts binding to UDS or loopback TCP, installs auth, registers services, and starts the CQ worker.

flows.title: Engine event to ordered state publication

steps.description: Delegates Recoil events to the current handler.
Engine-thread hooks append typed events and update lifetime metadata.
Drains pending faults and work, computes snapshot/delta ordering, then publishes.
Assigns a monotonic state sequence, stores the serialized update, and fans it out.
Serves fresh snapshot or ring replay and suppresses live messages already sent.

flows.title: Local SubmitCommands to native result and readback

steps.description: Claims the singleton AI stream and enforces batch sequencing.
Runs CommandValidator and creates normalized queued entries with correlation identity.
Atomically accepts the full batch only when bounded capacity permits.
On the engine thread, re-resolves mutable units and targets and creates a dispatch event.
Performs arm-specific current-native checks and calls the engine interface.
Records applied/skipped status and accepted order metadata; later state publications expose effects.

flows.title: Coordinator authority to guarded native dispatch

steps.description: Rotates paired channel incarnations and starts control, command and report workers.
Receives directives; channel loss rotates both incarnations and cancels stale gameplay input.
Validates full binding, monotonic control sequence, epoch, lease and directive kind.
Admits each live batch, enqueues accepted commands, and reports admission.
Checks authority, lease, basis and command deadlines, actor lifetime and target visibility.
Repeats fences under the authority mutex and invokes native dispatch in the guarded region.

flows.title: Tactical catalogue and observation to native tactical effect

steps.description: Builds a bounded content-addressed action catalogue and reports pages.
Samples a catalogue-bound basis, actors, queues, descriptors, economy and feature lifetimes.
Retains only snapshots matching the complete catalogue identity and revision.
Checks action descriptor, target, queue, definition and parameter policies.
Rechecks exact native queue/control/capability/site facts and writes one engine action when valid.

flows.title: Admin request to engine-thread mutation and audit

steps.description: Parses caller metadata and performs non-mutating validation on the CQ worker.
Checks role, run mode, bounds, target, staleness and lease conflict.
Places accepted execution in a bounded engine-thread queue and waits with a deadline.
Revalidates against current state and applies the action on the engine thread.
Records execution, updates pause/speed leases and emits an audit event.
Worker records the first pending fault without mutating engine-thread state.
Frame tick retrieves the fault on the engine thread.
Stops acceptance, evicts streams, closes services and records structured failure.
Atomically replaces the health file with disabled status and reason.

facts.statement: Built-in decision modules are active only when enableBuiltin is true; the gRPC gateway is activated independently.
Mutable engine actions are drained from queues on the engine frame thread.
A local command batch is enqueued atomically; insufficient capacity admits none of it.
Dispatch re-resolves mutable units and targets and repeats live/tactical fences immediately before native mutation.
A locally addressed live control directive engages the live session even if that directive is refused, preventing legacy gameplay bypass.
Loss of the control stream rotates both paired channel incarnations and cancels the gameplay stream.
Live dispatch requires a known basis whose retained expiry, queued basis deadline, command deadline and lease deadline are all current.
A tactical snapshot is accepted only against the complete current catalogue identity and revision.
Visible feature references carry lifetimes so an engine ID reused after disappearance cannot validate an old reference.
Tactical dispatch compares the requested queue revision/tag with the current native queue before action.
Ring-buffer state sequences must be strictly increasing.
After snapshot/replay, StreamState drops live messages whose sequence is not greater than the last sent sequence.
A slow observer is evicted rather than blocking state publication.
The embedded server binds only a Unix-domain socket or loopback TCP endpoint.
The gateway generates a 256-bit token, writes it atomically with private permissions, compares it in constant time, and unlinks it at shutdown.
Hello and observer StreamState bypass the token; mutating and sensitive RPCs are intercepted.
The actual AI producer lifetime is owned by the command stream singleton slot rather than a transient Hello.
Construction writes a healthy marker; fail-closed transition atomically writes disabled state with structured subsystem and reason.
Admin execution validates on receipt and again on the engine thread before mutation.
Pause and global-speed controls acquire caller-owned frame-expiring leases.
Command admission and native effect are distinct: admission is reported from transport processing, while applied/skipped dispatch appears in a later state delta.
An exception in a completion-queue handler is posted to the engine-thread fault sink and ultimately disables the gateway.
Canonical protobuf inputs are under proto/highbar; C++ output is generated into build/gen, F# consumes Grpc.Tools-generated C# types, and Python includes generated modules.
Standalone CMake covers support components, while full plugin, validator and engine-thread integration require configuring within the Recoil engine tree.
Documentation that describes only external decision control may be incomplete because this revision can activate built-in modules through enableBuiltin.

open_questions: Should architecture documentation explicitly describe the enableBuiltin coexistence mode, or is that path retained only for compatibility?
Which CI artifact is authoritative for the complete per-command-arm native effect-readback matrix beyond the generated 66-arm coverage list?
Are F# wrapper tests maintained in another repository? This revision contains samples and a latency bench but no comparable committed F# unit-test project.
Save/load and callback RPC implementations were indexed but not traced to the same depth as state, command, tactical, and admin flows.
Engine-coupled behavior was not freshly executed during this read-only analysis; validate callback ordering against the pinned Recoil runtime when modifying lifecycle-sensitive code.
